services.name: VDP_BuildTileRowCommandTables
services.behavior: Builds three 32-entry VDP tile-row command tables, selecting the C000/E000 plane order from FFF165 and advancing by the caller's D1 stride.

services.name: SceneTransition_VDPHelper
services.behavior: Programs VDP control word 0x9001, supplies an 0x80-byte row stride, and rebuilds the tile-row command tables.

services.name: SceneResource_WaitForCompletion
services.behavior: Polls until SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS becomes nonzero or the caller countdown expires, sampling query input and waiting for VBlank each iteration.

services.name: Terrain_QueryFlagDispatcher
services.behavior: Samples IO_PORT1_DATA through the I/O and Z80 handoff sequence and stores the raw query byte at FFF155.

services.name: Audio_QueueSceneUpdateIfPending
services.behavior: Queues audio command 4 only when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is set.

services.name: Terrain_QueryCallbackSetup
services.behavior: Writes D2 and D3 through the two VDP control/data command pairs used by scene and terrain setup paths.

conclusion: The shared transition helpers now expose the tile-row command-table builder, its scene-transition wrapper, the resource completion wait, raw query sampling, conditional scene-update audio notification, and the two-word VDP setup primitive.
